title: rehearsal berths among CodeMother's machines
intention: rehearsal berths at cairn/devices/codemother/machines/rehearsal/, owned by codemother with its gated_by unchanged, and every caller reaches it at that address without a RULE 1 red.
why: Child of 4c4addb09adb (CairnCommons/tickets/4c4addb09adb-the-code-pipeline-s-inspectors-and-gates-live-inside-codemother.json). Akien 2026-10-27 on Q#31 and open-0b203e62c1e0: 'everything that has no purpose other than helping our design and build pipeline for code belongs to code mother.' The split (2026-11-13): diagnostic_inspector stays in base (Akien on Q#40, open-0fa8fe4cb6bc: 'the basemost stuff belongs to cairn'); determinism, import_sieve and ticket_inspector stay tools CodeMother uses (outline 9.5 lists them under her TOOLS; Law 6: tools have users); plan_inspector, exemptions, corrosion and rehearsal are moves that repoint their callers; build_inspector over the bus (9.4.3.3.4, Q#88) is cast after the four.
traces_to: outline 10.3.5 and 9.4 (CodeMother owns the pipeline's inspectors); Law 6 (one owner gates writes); RULE 1 (encapsulation, outline 17.13.1)
how: D1: ORDER. Builds after the build_inspector child of 4c4addb09adb lands (that child, build_inspector over the bus per outline 9.4.3.3.4 and Q#88, is ticket 93fa3e3a6199, whose own children 266d39d56d06 (the inspect verb), 17d570c10390 (code sites over the bus) and 149b9a1ab9c4 (proofs over the bus) build before it). Measured 2026-11-13: encapsulation_holds (outline 17.13.1) reds code outside device codemother that imports cairn.devices.codemother.*, and build_inspector, still at cairn/machines/, imports this machine; once build_inspector is inside her, that import is inside one device and unchecked, while her importing cairn.machines.* was never a breach. So the move that would red RULE 1 today reads clean after. Where build_inspector's files then stand at cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/, the paths below that name cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py are read at that address (the harbor's forwarding carries the rename). D2: git mv cairn/machines/rehearsal/ cairn/devices/codemother/machines/rehearsal/ (code, proofs, validations, probes, charter, history, state; git mv keeps the bytes, history_integrity compares against HEAD at the new path after the commit). Its module path becomes cairn.devices.codemother.machines.rehearsal; every self-import and Path-join spelling inside the machine (e.g. REPO / 'cairn' / 'machines' / name) names the new address. Instance-space under ~/.cairn is untouched. D3: OWNERSHIP. The moved charter's owner names codemother; gated_by stays exactly as it stands (parent D3). The charter write rides the artifact door. D4: CALLERS, repointed in the same act. cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py:2370 (docstring), :2379 and :2414 (`from cairn.machines.rehearsal import rehearsal as R`); cairn/devices/codemother/machines/outline_check/outline_check.py:27 (inside codemother: legal once moved); bin/cmd/rehearse:21 and cairn/machines/build_inspector/sieves/runners_leave_trails.json:7 (`-m cairn.machines.rehearsal`, a subprocess the sieve cannot see, repointed so it still runs); bin/proofs/test_artifact_gate.py:150 and cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_rehearsal_lane_is_retired.py:76 (path strings to its charter); test_the_cast_refuses_decisions_a_rehearsal_cannot_read.py:4 (docstring). cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_ticket_is_three_files.py imports rehearsal at :637 and loads its probe a_failed_run_is_counted at :454: base's proof measures a codemother machine. The teeth that need R or that probe (test_a_crossing_moves_only_the_state_file's rehearsal half and r_failed_run) move, keeping their PROVES keys and ticket, into cairn/devices/codemother/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_rehearsal_reads_the_three_file_ticket.py; base's proof keeps the rest and imports nothing of rehearsal. D5: PROOF cairn/devices/codemother/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_rehearsal_berths_in_codemother.py, one tooth per clause, red-first: before the move clause 1 and 2 read red (the old directory stands; the old module path is imported). Clause 2's tooth is a git grep over tracked .py/.json/bin for the dotted, slash and Path-join spellings of the old address, excluding history.json, state.json, validations/ and .jsonl records. Then every proof under the new address reseals with bin/cairn test --seal --ruling <this id>.
